partial_progress.details: Phases 1-2 landed, verified (lake build 3325 jobs green, zero new sorries/axioms via lean_verify scan_source=false, no change to intExpandBranches.go), and committed as separate green phase commits. Phase 3's true scope was investigated and found substantially larger than its own Scope Hypothesis (a Lean auto-generated functional-induction principle, intExpandBranches.go.induct, is used at 4 separate call sites spanning roughly Scheme.lean:5767-8000+, so the call-site swap changes the induction's bound hypothesis type throughout, requiring generalization of ~8-10 more intStepBranch_* lemmas across dozens of call sites, not just the six sites Phase 2 covered). This finding was recorded in-plan (Scope Correction note under Phase 3) and committed separately, rather than silently absorbed. No Phase 3 code edits were attempted, since the phase is declared Commit Mode: atomic-batch and its true size could not be completed and verified (including a conformance-corpus lake test run) within this dispatch's remaining budget; starting it without finishing risked leaving uncommitted, correctness-critical changes to a termination-critical function.
